description: Quinteto Estelar es un equipo de cinco estudiantes con diferentes gustos, intereses y formas de pensar. Compartimos la pasión por actividades como el fútbol, los videojuegos, la música y la exploración. Nos caracterizamos por nuestra curiosidad, creatividad y disposición para trabajar en equipo. Nuestra motivación es vivir una nueva experiencia, aprender cosas nuevas, compartir conocimientos, afrontar desafíos y, sobre todo, disfrutar juntos de esta aventura.
summary:
🚀 Project Summary — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

Our project, “The Footprints That Never Fade,” aims to teach the history of five Mars explorers in a simple, fun, and interactive way: Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Perseverance, and Ingenuity.

Through a digital story with images, narration, animations, and questions, we want people of all ages to learn about NASA’s discoveries.

**Our goal is to show that even when space missions end, their discoveries remain important to science and can inspire future generations.

Our Mission: To spark curiosity about space and make learning about NASA an easy, educational, and enjoyable experience.
details:
🚀 Project Description — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

Our project, “The Footprints That Never Fade,” is an interactive digital story that teaches the history of five Mars explorers through images, animations, narration, and questions.

Benefits: Makes learning easier and inspires scientific curiosity in people of all ages.

Impact: Inspires future generations to explore space and appreciate NASA’s discoveries.

Tools: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and tools for creating images and audio.

Creativity: We combine real NASA facts with fictional characters and an interactive story.

Key Factors: Accessibility, ease of use, simple language, attractive design, and scientific accuracy.
